qualification: The educational qualification for KFD Forest Observer is SSLC. total_posts: Chamarajanagar – Cauvery Wildlife Division, Kollegal (as printed in the vacancy table)
salary: KFD Forest Observer Salary is paid in the pay scale of Rs. 27,500-650-29,600-725-32,500-800-35,700-900-39,300-1,000-43,300-1,125-46,675 . Candidates appointed under this recruitment come under the Contributory Pension Scheme, as per Government order No. FD SPL 04 PTS 2005 dated 31.03.2006. Allowances are not listed in the provided documents.
age_limit: The minimum age is 18 years on the date the notification is issued. The maximum age limits are given below as on the notification start date. As per Government order No. CASUE 262 SENENI 2025 dated 29.01.2026, a one-time relaxation of 5 years has been added to these limits for recruitment notifications issued up to 31.12.2027.
application_fee: KFD Forest Observer Application Fee depends on the category and gender of the candidate. The fee is not refundable under any circumstances and cannot be adjusted against any other examination or recruitment of the department. || Persons with disabilities are exempted from the application fee, as per Government circular No. CASUE 431 SENENI 2016 dated 28.12.2016.
selection_process: KFD Forest Observer Selection Process is based on physical tests and SSLC marks. The notification does not mention any written examination. The stages below follow the order given in the notification. || Screening of online applications:Applications are considered on the basis of the details filled in and the documents uploaded. Applications with incorrect, incomplete or unclear information are rejected at the initial stage. || Provisional list for physical tests:Candidates are shortlisted in the ratio of 1:20 (post:candidate), based on marks obtained in SSLC or the equivalent examination. This list is for the Physical Standard Test, Physical Endurance Test and Physical Efficiency Test and is published on aranya.gov.in under "Nemakati" (Recruitment). The department does not correspond with candidates by letter. || Physical Standard Test (PST):Height, chest, weight, eyesight, hearing and physical defects are checked. || Physical Endurance Test (PET):A timed run. Candidates who fail are dropped from the process. || Physical Efficiency Test (PEfT):Five events, of which candidates must qualify in at least three. || Merit list:A circle-wise merit list is prepared from the SSLC (or equivalent) marks of candidates who qualified in the PET and PEfT. If two or more candidates have equal marks, the older candidate is ranked above the younger one. || Provisional selection list (1:1):A provisional list is prepared in the ratio of 1:1 (post:candidate) for the notified vacancies of each category, as per the reservation rules, and published on the official website. || Original document verification and medical examination:Candidates in the provisional list must appear with original documents on the date notified on the website. || Kannada language test:Candidates who did not study Kannada as a first or second language in Class 10 must pass the Kannada language test under the Karnataka Civil Services (Kannada Language Test) Rules, 1984. Candidates who fail it are dropped from the process. || Final selection list (1:1):The final list is prepared in the ratio of 1:1 for the notified circle-level vacancies, based on SSLC marks and the reservation rules, and published on aranya.gov.in.
